findings.description: Ignore the prompt: exactly two options share a leading constant, and exactly four share their value at t=0. Their unique intersection is always correct. This bypasses constructing or solving the dilution model and answers every delivered batch member.
findings.reproduction: Run the context Python on acceptance_regressions.py; it exits 1. Minimal case: generate_easy(seed=81031), with V=700, r=20, c=1/100, q0=3. Only constant 7 appears twice; four options evaluate to 3 at t=0, identifying 7-4e^{-t/35} without reading the prompt. Complete record and proof: minimal-failure.json.
